description: This file defines the ReadableCustomer class, which extends CustomerEntity and adds a list of customer attributes. It is part of the web entity package for customer data in the project.

classes.name: ReadableCustomer
classes.description: Represents a customer with a list of customer attributes, extendable from CustomerEntity, and serializable for data transfer.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Sets the list of customer attributes.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves the list of customer attributes.
